nodes.label: EPKeyedRecord
nodes.description: A dictionary entry. _key is carried by the enclosing JSON/YAML map and need not be repeated inside its value.

nodes.label: EPPrefix
nodes.description: A declared CURIE prefix and expansion; serializes as a simple prefix-to-URI dictionary.

nodes.label: EPSelectionOrigin
nodes.description: Selection origin keyed by full mechanism ID; serializes as a simple string dictionary.

nodes.label: EPSourceRef
nodes.description: Location of an observation in one frozen source artifact.

nodes.label: EPBuilderPin
nodes.description: Version and exact source-code hash of the deterministic assembly implementation.

nodes.label: EPDapperPin
nodes.description: Pinned DAPPER schema and identity implementation dependency manifest.

nodes.label: EPIdentifierPolicy
nodes.description: Rules for interpreting record aliases and preserving minted DAPPER objects.

nodes.label: EPExpansionPolicy
nodes.description: One direct expansion round from the original selected mechanisms.

nodes.label: EPSemanticRetrieval
nodes.description: Semantic selection metadata; uncomputed scores must not be invented.

nodes.label: EPSelection
nodes.description: The exact gap and anchor set submitted by the caller.

nodes.label: EPSourceRevision
nodes.description: Frozen DisMech source revision and selected document checksum.

nodes.label: EPRepositoryOrigin
nodes.description: Repository location of a frozen source document.

nodes.label: EPSourceArtifact
nodes.description: Content-addressed source artifact with a durable DAPPER File identity. Transport input paths are not part of this descriptor.

nodes.label: EPRawObject
nodes.description: Opaque upstream JSON object. Fields are preserved, not reinterpreted or validated as DAPPER. Only explicitly identified source boundaries are open.

nodes.label: EPJSONValue
nodes.description: Any JSON value, used only as the base range of explicitly constrained source unions.

nodes.label: EPAttachment
nodes.description: An indexed DisMech attachment, including unresolved outcomes.

nodes.label: EPKnowledgeGapContext
nodes.description: Selected natural-language gap with its original DisMech context and exact DAPPER binding.

nodes.label: EPSemanticAssociation
nodes.description: Retrieval association only; semantic similarity does not constitute biological evidence.

nodes.label: EPDismechMechanism
nodes.description: Raw DisMech pathophysiology record plus typed application bindings. Additional curated source fields are intentionally preserved.

nodes.label: EPAttachedContext
nodes.description: A linked non-mechanism DisMech item or entire section/document.

nodes.label: EPRawList
nodes.description: Opaque upstream array for a whole-section attachment. Its members remain source data.

nodes.label: EPRelatedGap
nodes.description: A related same-document gap that cannot replace the selected question.

nodes.label: EPRelatedGaps
nodes.description: Bounded related knowledge-gap context.

nodes.label: EPDismechContext
nodes.description: The selected gap, linked mechanisms and other curated source context.

nodes.label: EPFit
nodes.description: Exact PIGEAN/EAGGL trait-specific fit. A factor is a mechanism in this application.

nodes.label: EPInteractiveObservation
nodes.description: Interactive direct-edge measurements, with metric names and numeric precision preserved.

nodes.label: EPLoadingObservation
nodes.description: One entity-to-mechanism relationship, optionally enriched with its BioIndex loading. Scores are not causal probabilities.

nodes.label: EPLoadingCollection
nodes.description: Retained relationships plus the overall typed-query outcome, distinguishing empty from missing.

nodes.label: EPMechanismEvidence
nodes.description: A selected EAGGL mechanism, exact fit and gene/gene-set/trait observations.

nodes.label: EPReportedMetrics
nodes.description: Named PIGEAN metrics preserved without a shared confidence transformation.

nodes.label: EPTraitObservation
nodes.description: A source occurrence from a factor or phenotype query. Duplicate occurrences are not independent corroboration.

nodes.label: EPTraitEntityObservations
nodes.description: All retained source occurrences for one gene or gene set within this trait.

nodes.label: EPTraitAssociations
nodes.description: Retained trait observations, keyed by full source entity ID.

nodes.label: EPTraitEvidence
nodes.description: Trait-level associations retain both factor-query and dedicated phenotype-query occurrences.

nodes.label: EPGraphNode
nodes.description: Native interactive graph node metadata.

nodes.label: EPGraphEdge
nodes.description: Captured interactive edge, retaining native identity, scores and optional upstream metadata. A path does not itself establish membership or causality.

nodes.label: EPRetainedEdge
nodes.description: Deduplicated edge with every captured source occurrence.

nodes.label: EPSupportingPath
nodes.description: Native interactive path metadata used to rank a candidate; not a new DAPPER evidence-item class.

nodes.label: EPInteractiveCandidate
nodes.description: Candidate and ranking statistics as returned by the interactive API.

nodes.label: EPCandidateEvidence
nodes.description: Retained candidate, native record and exact source locator.

nodes.label: EPGraph
nodes.description: Bounded retained graph. Endpoint closure and duplicate edge IDs are verified by the builder.

nodes.label: EPContextualRelationships
nodes.description: Outcome of the single contextual-edges query, including deduplication counts.

nodes.label: EPPigeanEvidence
nodes.description: Mechanism and trait observations from the selected CFDE model, with a bounded graph.

nodes.label: EPGeneBinding
nodes.description: Source-local gene symbol; no external gene identity mapping is inferred.

nodes.label: EPGeneSetBinding
nodes.description: Exact imported DAPPER GeneSet identity; catalog presence does not verify membership or original construction provenance.

nodes.label: EPEntities
nodes.description: Entity-to-DAPPER or source-local identity bindings.

nodes.label: EPQueryOutcomes
nodes.description: All four typed expansion outcomes and the contextual query outcome.

nodes.label: EPBioIndexProgress
nodes.description: Upstream byte progress; continuation null is not evidence of exhaustive coverage.

nodes.label: EPBioIndexCoverage
nodes.description: One bounded BioIndex source query.

nodes.label: EPCoverage
nodes.description: Captured/retained graph counts and explicit omissions. No common upstream build or exhaustive retrieval is assumed.

nodes.label: EPBuildPolicy
nodes.description: Deterministic retention limits. A byte limit does not replace the agent-model tokenizer budget.

nodes.label: EPInstruction
nodes.description: Exact frozen authoring instruction artifact.

nodes.label: EPAuthoring
nodes.description: Frozen skill and scientific contracts, with the exact selected question required for each authored account.

nodes.label: EPExternalEvidence
nodes.description: Initial enrichment configuration. Queries and assertions are added to a later append-only ledger, never this frozen package.

nodes.label: EPReadiness
nodes.description: Capture validity and remaining worker checks; capture completeness is not dispatch authorization.

nodes.label: EPDapperContext
nodes.description: Trusted hydrated DAPPER objects. Imported classes are reused from the pinned snapshot, not redefined. Identity digests and dependency closure require the DAPPER validator.

nodes.label: EvidencePackage
nodes.description: Frozen application input for the scientific-account agent. Stable application sections are closed; only raw source boundaries are extensible.

nodes.label: EPQueryStatus
nodes.description: Availability of a bounded query or retained collection. Empty does not imply biological absence.

nodes.label: EPSimilarityStatus
nodes.description: Whether semantic similarity was actually measured.

nodes.label: EPNodeType
nodes.description: Supported interactive graph entity types.

nodes.label: EPArtifactFormat
nodes.description: Serialization of the exact source bytes.

nodes.label: EPAttachmentResolution
nodes.description: DisMech attachment lookup outcome.

nodes.label: EPGapKind
nodes.description: Kinds accepted by the gap collector.

nodes.label: EPNotQueried
nodes.description: Initial packages have no external enrichment results.

nodes.label: EPProvidedSubset
nodes.description: Related questions are a bounded supplied subset.

nodes.label: EPSha256
nodes.description: Lowercase SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 or binary bytes.

nodes.label: EPSourcePointer
nodes.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into a saved structured artifact; empty string selects the root.

nodes.label: EPFactorID
nodes.description: Full CFDE interactive mechanism identity including trait group, phenotype, model and factor.
